method: Compared Anthropic stop-reason and tool-call documentation with the complete lesson. Executed the complete Python FakeModel fence and ran 9 offline assertions, including empty end_turn and no dispatch for a tool proposal on the last model turn. No provider or external network call. Isolated production build generated 399 pages and Pagefind indexed 399 pages / 15,393 words. Light/dark full-page screenshots were visually inspected at 1300px: viewport/document width=1300px, article width=792px, Mermaid rendered; the only console error was favicon 404.

checks: empty end_turn is rejected instead of being returned as an answer
task acceptance remains distinct from model-turn termination
max_steps counts model responses rather than tool calls
final-turn tool proposals are not dispatched without a remaining model turn
historical DeepSeek response and error excerpts remain unverified
isolated production build and search index rendered the revised lesson in light and dark modes

limitations: The full FakeModel fence is deterministic teaching code and does not establish provider behavior or production safety.
The 2026-10-12 DeepSeek raw requests/responses and exact endpoint snapshot were not archived; the displayed transcript and 400 messages were not independently reproduced.
No real provider, live API, or external network request was made.
The only browser console error was the missing favicon (404); no lesson rendering or layout errors were observed.
